senses.zh_definition: 若原文指 Warner，则为外文人名或姓氏，通常音译为“沃纳”；在 Warner Bros. 等机构名称中通常采用既有中文译名，如“华纳兄弟”。
senses.en_definition: If the intended form is Warner, a personal name or surname, also occurring in organization names such as Warner Bros.
senses.ms_definition: Jika yang dimaksudkan ialah Warner, nama khas orang atau nama keluarga yang juga terdapat dalam nama organisasi seperti Warner Bros.
senses.nuances: 本项按名词类容纳专名，不表示已经确认 warner 是马来语普通名词。输入没有上下文，不能确定它指某个人、机构，还是其他外语用法。专名通常首字母大写；下列搭配仅示范 Warner Bros. 这一可核实的名称。[名称实例与历史](https://amhistory.si.edu/docs/wb_bogart_film_festival.pdf)

etymology.historical_story: One documented cultural use of Warner is the studio name Warner Bros. A historical note from the company identifies Albert, Harry, Jack, and Sam Warner as its four founding brothers in 1923. This explains that particular company name; it does not establish the intended referent of the lowercase token supplied here. [Warner Bros. historical note](https://amhistory.si.edu/docs/wb_bogart_film_festival.pdf)
